opening.argument: Forsage is presented as a work-from-home cryptocurrency earnings program, and the promised long-term residual income is tied directly to recruiting three people who then repeat the referral. That structure makes participant recruitment the stated path to earnings, rather than describing income independent of bringing in others. The video does not explain how earnings or participation operate, so the claim establishes neither a particular outcome nor that anyone will profit. But the central offer is clear: residual income through a repeating referral chain.

citations.quote: Forsage is a smart contract crypto earnings program that you work from home at your own leisure
it enables you to earn a long-term residual income just by referring this to three other people and asking them to do the same as you
